collect_env_info: call collect_env to gather CUDA, GPU, PyTorch, OpenCV, and MMCV environment details into a dictionary
check_cuda_availability: use collect_env to check if CUDA is available and list GPU device names and IDs
inspect_compiler_versions: run collect_env to retrieve GCC, MSVC, and NVCC compiler version information
debug_pytorch_build: call collect_env to inspect PyTorch version and compiling details for debugging build issues
verify_mmcv_setup: use collect_env to verify MMCV version and its compiler and CUDA compiler versions
